notes.title: Brief Karate Foolish will fulfill your dream of fighting as a half-nude Japanese man
notes.notes: The motto of Brief Karate Foolish [official site] ran through Google Translate is: “First of all, discard reason. Everything is from then!” This free “super real match fighting game,” is all about the majesty and grace of brief-wearing Japanese men fighting to the death for a mystical pair of black briefs. That sounds like a typical Friday night for me, only I’d prefer to wear a unicorn head to top off the ensemble. … [visit site to read more]
